caption: LUM-1328 follow-up — composer border: the input area now carries upstream pi's editor chrome, one `─` rule above the draft and one below it, painted in the editor border colour (bash mode / thinking level). Before this round the port had no border at all (`paint_prompt`: 'The Rust prompt has no border, so the label carries the colour instead') and reported a clipped draft in the label gutter; now the rules report it the way upstream's `createScrollBorder` does (` ↑ 3 more `). No side borders — upstream's editor says so in as many words (`components/editor.ts:597`). Every frame is a real PTY at 76x26 driving the debug binary built from this commit (`--model faux/faux-model`).
